name: Incredible India
tagline: One subcontinent, four directions, infinite stories.
headline: From the Himalayas to the Tip of the Subcontinent

groups.name: Kerala
groups.tagline: 9 Nights, 10 Days · Cochin, Munnar, Alleppey, Thekkady, Kanyakumari, Trivandrum

offer.summary: 10 days trip built around Cochin, Munnar, Alleppey, Thekkady, Kanyakumari, Trivandrum at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Cochin: Discover colonial charm, Chinese fishing nets, colourful markets and the historic waterfront of Fort Kochi.
Munnar: Escape into misty tea gardens, rolling valleys and cool mountain landscapes in Kerala's beloved hill station.
Alleppey: Drift through emerald backwaters and quiet paddy fields aboard a traditional Kerala houseboat.
Thekkady: Explore Periyar's wildlife-rich forests through scenic lake cruises, spice plantations and jungle adventures.
Kanyakumari: Watch the sun rise and set where three seas meet, beside Vivekananda Rock Memorial and the Thiruvalluvar Statue.
Trivandrum: Experience Kerala's cultural capital through the magnificent Padmanabhaswamy Temple, museums and nearby coastal escapes.

groups.name: Goa
groups.tagline: 5 Nights, 6 Days · North Goa, Panaji, Old Goa, South Goa, Dudhsagar Falls

offer.summary: 6 days trip built around North Goa, Panaji, Old Goa, South Goa, Dudhsagar Falls at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: North Goa: Unwind on the lively shores of Baga, Calangute and Anjuna, with vibrant beach shacks, water sports and Goa's famous nightlife.
Panaji: Wander the Portuguese-era streets of Fontainhas, admire the Church of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception and stroll along the Mandovi riverfront.
Old Goa: Discover UNESCO-listed heritage at the Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral, home to centuries of Indo-Portuguese history.
South Goa: Relax on the tranquil, palm-fringed sands of Palolem and Agonda, a quieter counterpoint to the north's energy.
Dudhsagar Falls: Trek or jeep through Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary to this dramatic four-tiered waterfall cascading through the Western Ghats.

groups.name: Lakshadweep
groups.tagline: 4 Nights, 5 Days · Kavaratti, Agatti, Bangaram, Kadmat, Minicoy

offer.summary: 5 days trip built around Kavaratti, Agatti, Bangaram, Kadmat, Minicoy at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you. Rate Valid for minimum 10 PAX travelling together
highlights: Kavaratti: Explore the union territory's capital island, with its pristine lagoon, Ujra Mosque and the Marine Aquarium showcasing vibrant reef life.
Agatti: Arrive through the archipelago's main gateway, framed by a stunning turquoise lagoon perfect for water sports and glass-bottom boat rides.
Bangaram: Unwind on this uninhabited coral island, a serene retreat of powder-white sands and some of the clearest waters in the region.
Kadmat: Dive into vibrant coral reefs and snorkel among tropical marine life along one of Lakshadweep's most acclaimed dive destinations.
Minicoy: Discover the archipelago's second-largest island, known for its towering lighthouse, tuna fishing traditions and distinct Mahl culture.

groups.name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands
groups.tagline: 6 Nights, 7 Days · Port Blair, Havelock Island, Neil Island, Baratang Island, Ross Island

offer.summary: 6 days trip built around Port Blair, Havelock Island, Neil Island, Baratang Island, Ross Island at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Port Blair: Step into colonial history at the Cellular Jail, explore the Anthropological Museum and enjoy the sound-and-light show retelling India's freedom struggle.
Havelock Island: Relax on the powdery sands of Radhanagar Beach, dive among vibrant coral reefs and enjoy world-class snorkelling in the Andaman Sea.
Neil Island: Discover a laid-back island paradise with natural rock bridges, Bharatpur Beach and vibrant coral gardens ideal for a relaxed getaway.
Baratang Island: Cruise through dense mangrove creeks to the limestone caves and the rare mud volcanoes hidden within the tropical rainforest.
Ross Island: Wander the ruins of this former British administrative headquarters, now reclaimed by nature, with colonial remnants and resident deer roaming free.

groups.name: Andhra Pradesh
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur, Nellore, Kurnool

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur, Nellore, Kurnool at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Visakhapatnam: Enjoy golden beaches, Kailasagiri's hilltop views, Borra Caves and the city's refreshing Bay of Bengal charm.
Vijayawada: Visit the sacred Kanaka Durga Temple and admire the Krishna River from Prakasam Barrage.
Guntur: Discover the ancient Buddhist legacy of Amaravati, Kondaveedu Fort and the tranquil Uppalapadu Bird Sanctuary.
Nellore: Experience serene wetlands, birdlife and coastal charm through Pulicat Lake, Nellapattu Sanctuary and Mypadu Beach.
Kurnool: Explore Konda Reddy Fort, the dramatic Orvakal Rock Garden and the spiritual landscapes of Mantralayam.

groups.name: Telangana
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Hyderabad, Warangal, Nizamabad, Karimnagar

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Hyderabad, Warangal, Nizamabad, Karimnagar at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Hyderabad: Explore the City of Pearls, famous for the iconic Charminar, Golconda Fort, and its rich Nizami heritage and vibrant cuisine. Explore the Bollywood inspired Ramoji Film City Theme Park
Warangal: Discover the historic Kakatiya legacy through the ancient Warangal Fort, Thousand Pillar Temple, and Ramappa Temple.
Nizamabad: Experience the blend of history and nature at the Nizamabad Fort, Alisagar Reservoir, and the scenic Pocharam Wildlife Sanctuary.
Karimnagar: Immerse yourself in the cultural and architectural beauty of the Lower Manair Dam, Elgandal Fort, and ancient temples.

groups.name: Tamil Nadu
groups.tagline: 6 Nights, 7 Days · Ooty, Rameswaram, Kodaikanal, Madurai

offer.summary: 7 days trip built around Ooty, Rameswaram, Kodaikanal, Madurai at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Ooty: Relax among tea gardens, emerald hills, Ooty Lake and the charming Nilgiri Mountain Railway.
Rameswaram: Experience the spiritual beauty of Ramanathaswamy Temple, sacred Agnitheertham, Dhanushkodi and the sea-linked Pamban Bridge.
Kodaikanal: Wander through misty forests, serene Kodai Lake, Coaker's Walk, waterfalls and dramatic hill viewpoints.
Madurai: Admire the magnificent Meenakshi Amman Temple and immerse yourself in the vibrant soul of Tamil Nadu's cultural capital.

groups.name: Karnataka
groups.tagline: 6 Nights, 7 Days · Bengaluru, Mysuru, Coorg, Chikkaballapur

offer.summary: 7 days trip built around Bengaluru, Mysuru, Coorg, Chikkaballapur at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Bengaluru: Discover India's vibrant tech city through its leafy parks, modern culture, historic palaces and lively cafés.
Mysuru: Step into royal grandeur at the illuminated Mysuru Palace, with Chamundi Hills and Brindavan Gardens adding timeless charm.
Coorg: Escape into misty coffee plantations, lush forests and cascading waterfalls in Karnataka's serene hill country.
Chikkaballapur (Nandi Hills): Welcome the sunrise from a peaceful hilltop of sweeping views, ancient temples and Tipu Sultan's historic retreat.

groups.name: Himachal Pradesh Cluster 1
groups.tagline: 6 Nights, 7 Days · Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, Kullu, McLeod Ganj

offer.summary: 7 days trip built around Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, Kullu, McLeod Ganj at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Shimla: Stroll along the Ridge and Mall Road, surrounded by colonial architecture, pine-covered hills and timeless mountain charm.
Manali: Discover snow-dusted peaks, the Hadimba Temple, Solang Valley and exhilarating Himalayan adventures.
Dharamshala: Unwind amid cedar forests, mountain views, waterfalls and the peaceful atmosphere of Tibetan spirituality.
Kullu: Follow the beautiful Beas Valley through lush landscapes, riverside scenery, traditional temples and vibrant local culture.
McLeod Ganj: Experience Tibetan heritage at the Tsuglagkhang Complex, Namgyal Monastery and the home of the Dalai Lama.

groups.name: Himachal Pradesh Cluster 2
groups.tagline: 10 Nights, 11 Days · Narkanda, Sangla, Kinnaur & Kalpa, Tabo, Hurling, Kaza, Chandratal, Losar, Sarahan, Manali, Kasol, Jispa

offer.summary: 11 days trip built around Narkanda, Sangla, Kinnaur & Kalpa, Tabo, Hurling, Kaza, Chandratal, Losar, Sarahan, Manali, Kasol, and Jispa at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you. Rate Valid for minimum 4 PAX travelling together
highlights: Narkanda: Escape into pine forests and apple orchards, with beautiful Himalayan panoramas from Hatu Peak.
Sangla: Follow the tranquil Baspa River through a dramatic valley of forested slopes, mountain villages and Kamru Fort.
Kinnaur & Kalpa: Admire the snow-dusted Kinner Kailash range, apple orchards and serene villages shaped by Hindu and Buddhist traditions.
Tabo: Visit the ancient Tabo Monastery, a stunning 1,000-year-old complex nestled in the barren, dramatic landscapes of Spiti.
Hurling: Explore this quiet, charming village in Spiti Valley, offering a glimpse into remote mountain life and traditional architecture.
Kaza: Experience the bustling heart of Spiti, a high-altitude town surrounded by rocky peaks, ancient monasteries and mountain passes.
Chandratal: Marvel at the moon-shaped, crystal-clear lake set against a backdrop of stark, jagged mountains at high altitude.
Losar: Discover the serene, high-altitude village of Losar, the first major settlement on the way to Kunzum Pass, famed for its rugged beauty.
Sarahan: Find peaceful mountain beauty at the revered Bhima Kali Temple, framed by forests and distant Himalayan peaks.
Manali: Discover snow-dusted peaks, the Hadimba Temple, Solang Valley and exhilarating Himalayan adventures.
Kasol: Unwind in the Parvati Valley, known for its scenic river views, vibrant café culture and relaxed hippie-haven atmosphere.
Jispa: Relax in this picturesque village beside the Bhaga River, a peaceful stopover offering grand mountain vistas and starlit skies.

groups.name: Uttarakhand Cluster 2
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Adi Kailash, Om Parvat, Haridwar

offer.summary: 6 days trip built around Adi Kailash, Om Parvat, Haridwar at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you. Rate Valid for minimum 4 PAX travelling together
highlights: Adi Kailash: Experience the spiritual majesty of this sacred Himalayan peak, revered as a replica of Mount Kailash and surrounded by breathtaking, untouched alpine scenery.
Om Parvat: Witness the awe-inspiring natural formation of the 'Om' symbol on this snow-capped peak, a deeply spiritual destination in the remote Himalayas.
Haridwar: Immerse yourself in the spiritual energy of this ancient holy city, where the Ganges flows from the mountains, famous for its mesmerizing evening Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri.

groups.name: Uttarakhand Cluster 3
groups.tagline: 0 Nights, 1 Day · Auli, Kuari Pass, Garhwal Range

offer.summary: Adventurous trekking trip built around Auli, Kuari Pass, Garhwal Range at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you. Rate Valid for minimum 8 PAX travelling together
highlights: Auli: Experience India's premier skiing destination, offering pristine snowy slopes and stunning vistas of Nanda Devi and other towering Himalayan peaks.
Kuari Pass: Embark on the legendary 'Curzon Trail,' a breathtaking trek that winds through ancient forests and high meadows, rewarding hikers with panoramic views of the Garhwal Himalayas.
Garhwal Range: Immerse yourself in the majestic beauty of this iconic mountain region, home to some of the world's most spectacular trekking routes, high-altitude lakes, and spiritual landscapes.

groups.name: Kashmir Cluster 1
groups.tagline: 8 Nights, 9 Days · Srinagar, Sonmarg, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Panjtarni, Amarnath, Katra (Vaishno Devi)

offer.summary: 6 days trip built around Srinagar, Sonmarg, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Panjtarni, Amarnath, Katra (Vaishno Devi) at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Srinagar: Glide across Dal Lake by shikara, surrounded by Mughal gardens, houseboats and the timeless beauty of Kashmir.
Sonmarg: Discover the "Meadow of Gold," framed by alpine valleys, Thajiwas Glacier and snow-dusted mountain trails.
Gulmarg: Enjoy vast flower-filled meadows, the famous Gulmarg Gondola and breathtaking Himalayan winter scenery.
Pahalgam: Follow the peaceful Lidder River through pine forests and mountain valleys, while beginning the traditional Amarnath route.
Panjtarni: Rest amid high-altitude Himalayan landscapes at the sacred Amarnath transit camp, where five streams are believed to flow from Lord Shiva's hair.
Amarnath: Complete a deeply spiritual pilgrimage to the sacred cave and naturally formed ice lingam of Lord Amarnath.
Katra (Vaishno Devi): Begin the sacred 13-km pilgrimage through the Trikuta Hills to Mata Vaishno Devi Bhawan, with the option to visit Ardhkuwari and Bhairon Nath Temple.

groups.name: Kashmir Cluster 2
groups.tagline: 6 Nights, 7 Days · Yusmarg, Gurez Valley, Bangus Valley, Lolab Valley, Aharbal, Daksum, Sinthan Top

offer.summary: 6 days trip built around Yusmarg, Gurez Valley, Bangus Valley, Lalab Valley, Aharbal, Sinthan Top at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Yusmarg: Discover the "Meadow of Jesus," a serene hill station offering vast green pastures, pine-covered slopes, and the tranquil Doodh Ganga river.
Gurez Valley: Experience the remote, pristine beauty of this border valley, famed for its dramatic Habba Khatoon peak, crystal-clear Kishanganga river, and traditional wooden architecture.
Bangus Valley: Explore this hidden, high-altitude alpine meadow, characterized by its lush, untouched grasslands, dense forests, and complete serenity far from the tourist crowds.
Lalab Valley: Wander through this lush valley known as the "Fruit Bowl of Kashmir," featuring cherry and walnut orchards, rolling hills, and peaceful rural landscapes.
Aharbal: Marvel at the spectacular Aharbal Waterfall, where the Veshaw River cascades dramatically, creating a powerful and mesmerizing misty spectacle.
Sinthan Top: Drive to this high-mountain pass offering panoramic Himalayan vistas, lush meadows, and the unique experience of witnessing snow even in the summer months.

groups.name: Ladakh
groups.tagline: 12 Nights, 13 Days · Leh, Kargil, Pangong Lake, Khardong La Pass, Hunder, Sumur, Hanle, Tso Moriri

offer.summary: 13 days trip built around Leh, Kargil, Pangong Lake, Khardong La Pass, Hunder, Sumur, Hanle, Tso Moriri at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Leh: Explore Ladakh's cultural heart through Leh Palace, Shanti Stupa, colourful markets and ancient monasteries.
Kargil: Journey through rugged Himalayan valleys and historic mountain landscapes along the gateway to Ladakh's western frontier.
Pangong Lake: Marvel at crystal-blue waters changing shades beneath stark, majestic mountains on the Indo-Tibetan frontier.
Khardung La Pass: Cross one of Ladakh's most legendary high passes, surrounded by sweeping snow-capped Himalayan panoramas.
Hunder: Experience Nubra's surreal meeting of golden sand dunes, rugged mountains and rare double-humped Bactrian camels.
Sumur: Discover a peaceful Nubra village framed by river valleys, orchards and the serene Samstanling Monastery.
Hanle: Gaze into exceptionally clear Himalayan skies at one of the world's highest astronomical observatories.
Tso Moriri: Find quiet beauty beside this pristine high-altitude lake, set amid the vast and untouched Changthang Plateau.

groups.name: Arunachal Pradesh
groups.tagline: 8 Nights, 9 Days · Bhalukpong, Dirang, Tawang, Bomdila, Guwahati

offer.summary: 9 days trip built around Bhalukpong, Dirang, Tawang, Bomdila, Guwahati at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Bhalukpong: Enter Arunachal through forested valleys, clear rivers and peaceful landscapes ideal for nature walks and river adventures.
Dirang: Unwind amid apple and kiwi orchards, hot springs, monasteries and the serene beauty of Sangti Valley.
Tawang: Discover the magnificent Tawang Monastery, Sela Pass, frozen lakes, Nuranang Falls and unforgettable Himalayan panoramas.
Bomdila: Enjoy cool mountain air, Buddhist monasteries and sweeping views of snow-clad Himalayan peaks.
Guwahati: Begin or end the journey with Kamakhya Temple, Brahmaputra views and the city's vibrant Assamese cultural spirit.

groups.name: Uttar Pradesh
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Lucknow, Kanpur, Agra, Varanasi, Ayodhya

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Lucknow, Kanpur, Agra, Varanasi, Ayodhya at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Lucknow: Explore the city of Nawabs, famed for its rich cultural heritage, architectural wonders like the Bara Imambara, and exquisite Awadhi cuisine.
Kanpur: Discover the industrial and historical significance of this riverside city, with its blend of colonial history, spiritual sites like Jajmau, and bustling markets.
Agra: Witness the timeless beauty of the Taj Mahal, explore the majestic Agra Fort and soak in the Mughal-era history of this iconic destination.
Varanasi: Immerse yourself in the spiritual heartbeat of India, with sacred Ganges ghats, ancient temples like Kashi Vishwanath and mesmerizing evening aarti ceremonies.
Ayodhya: Visit the birthplace of Lord Rama, a city steeped in mythology, featuring the grand Ram Mandir and serene banks of the Saryu River.

groups.name: Maharashtra
groups.tagline: 11 Nights, 12 Days · Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, Nashik, Thane & Navi Mumbai, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Kolhapur, Amravati, Akola, Jalgaon & Dhule

offer.summary: 12 days trip built around Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, Nashik, Thane & Navi Mumbai, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Kolhapur, Amravati, Akola, Jalgaon & Dhule at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Mumbai: Explore the vibrant pulse of India's financial capital, from the historic Gateway of India and Marine Drive to bustling markets and iconic Bollywood culture.
Pune: Discover the cultural heart of Maharashtra, blending historic landmarks like Shaniwar Wada with lush hill stations and academic heritage.
Nagpur: Experience the Orange City's unique blend of vibrant markets, ancient temples, and nearby wildlife sanctuaries like Pench and Tadoba.
Nashik: Visit the Wine Capital of India, renowned for its sprawling vineyards, ancient cave temples like Pandavleni, and the holy Godavari River ghats.
Thane & Navi Mumbai: Enjoy the scenic beauty of Thane's lakes and creeks, alongside the planned, modern infrastructure and waterfront promenades of Navi Mumbai.
Pimpri-Chinchwad: Explore this dynamic urban hub known for its industrial progress, well-planned parks, and proximity to scenic hill getaways.
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar: Step back in time with historic wonders like Bibi Ka Maqbara and the world-renowned Ajanta and Ellora Caves nearby.
Kolhapur: Immerse yourself in rich tradition, visiting the magnificent Mahalakshmi Temple and enjoying the city's legendary culinary heritage and wrestling culture.
Amravati: Discover the gateway to the Satpuda Range, featuring ancient temples, serene forests, and the nearby Chikhaldara hill station.
Akola: Discover Balapur and Narnala Forts, peaceful temples and the wild landscapes of Katepurna Sanctuary.
Jalgaon & Dhule: Explore Jalgaon's Patna Devi and Unapdev hot springs, then discover Dhule's Laling Fort, waterfalls and Aner Dam Sanctuary.

groups.name: Rajasthan
groups.tagline: 15 Nights, 16 Days · Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Jaisalmer, Bikaner, Ajmer & Pushkar, Ranthambore, Kota, Chittorgarh, Bharatpur, Mount Abu

highlights: Jaipur: Explore the Pink City through Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace and vibrant royal bazaars.
Jodhpur: Admire the mighty Mehrangarh Fort, the azure-hued old city and the architectural elegance of Umaid Bhawan Palace.
Udaipur: Sail across Lake Pichola and immerse yourself in the romance of City Palace, island retreats and serene waters.
Jaisalmer: Discover the Golden Fort, intricate havelis and the magical dunes of the Thar Desert through a camel safari.
Bikaner: Wander through grand forts, ornate havelis and the unique desert character of Rajasthan's Red City.
Ajmer & Pushkar: Visit the sacred Ajmer Sharif Dargah and experience the spiritual charm of Pushkar's holy lake and Brahma Temple.
Ranthambore: Venture into the wilderness on thrilling safaris through tiger-rich forests, framed by ancient fortress ruins.
Kota: Enjoy peaceful views of the Chambal River, historic Kota Garh and a heritage defined by lush gardens.
Chittorgarh: Relive Rajput history at the expansive Chittorgarh Fort, anchored by the magnificent Vijay Stambh.
Bharatpur: Explore Keoladeo National Park, a tranquil sanctuary for migratory birds, wetlands and diverse biodiversity.
Mount Abu: Escape into the Aravalli hills to find Nakki Lake, Guru Shikhar and the exquisite artistry of Dilwara Temples.

groups.name: Punjab
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Amritsar, Patiala, Chandigarh, Anandpur Sahib

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Amritsar, Patiala, Chandigarh, Anandpur Sahib at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Amritsar: Experience the spiritual glow of the Golden Temple, reflect at Jallianwala Bagh and witness the spirited Wagah Border Ceremony.
Patiala: Step into Punjab's royal heritage at Qila Mubarak, Sheesh Mahal and the graceful Baradari Gardens.
Chandigarh: Discover modernist beauty through the imaginative Rock Garden, peaceful Sukhna Lake and vibrant Rose Garden.
Anandpur Sahib: Connect with Sikh history at Takht Sri Kesgarh Sahib, the birthplace of the Khalsa, and explore its serene Shivalik setting.

highlights: Ahmedabad: Explore the UNESCO-listed old city, Sabarmati Ashram, Adalaj Stepwell and vibrant Gujarati street-food culture.
Surat: Experience the city's textile and diamond heritage, lively markets, Dutch Garden and relaxing Dumas Beach.
Vadodara: Admire the grandeur of Laxmi Vilas Palace, Sayaji Garden and the city's rich art and royal heritage.
Rajkot: Discover Gandhi's legacy at Kaba Gandhi No Delo, explore Watson Museum and enjoy the city's warm cultural spirit.
Gandhinagar: Visit the magnificent Akshardham Temple and enjoy the capital's peaceful gardens, wide avenues and modern architecture.
Bhuj: Step into Kutch's heritage through historic walled streets, colourful handicrafts, traditional textiles and nearby desert landscapes.
Dhordo: Experience the ethereal White Rann, vibrant Rann Utsav, Banni culture and breathtaking salt-desert sunsets.

groups.name: Madhya Pradesh
groups.tagline: 20 Nights, 21 Days · Indore, Bhopal, Jabalpur, Gwalior, Ujjain, Khajuraho, Sanchi, Pachmarhi, Mandu, Bandhavgarh & Kanha, Omkareshwar

highlights: Indore: Savour the city's vibrant food culture, grand Rajwada Palace and the beautiful Lal Bagh Palace.

Jabalpur: Cruise past Bhedaghat's gleaming Marble Rocks and witness the powerful Dhuandhar Falls.
Gwalior: Explore the majestic Gwalior Fort, ornate Jai Vilas Palace and the city's regal musical legacy.
Ujjain: Seek blessings at the revered Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga and experience the spiritual rhythm of the Shipra River.
Khajuraho: Admire UNESCO-listed temples adorned with exquisite sculptures and timeless architectural artistry.
Sanchi: Step into India's Buddhist heritage at the magnificent Great Stupa, Ashoka Pillar and ancient monasteries.
Pachmarhi: Escape to the "Queen of Satpura," surrounded by forested hills, waterfalls, caves and peaceful viewpoints.
Mandu: Wander through romantic Afghan-style ruins, including Jahaz Mahal, Hindola Mahal and Rupmati Pavilion.
Bandhavgarh & Kanha: Venture into lush tiger country, where thrilling safaris reveal Bengal tigers, sal forests and rich wildlife.
Omkareshwar: Visit the sacred Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga, beautifully set on an island formed by the Narmada River.

groups.name: Chhattisgarh
groups.tagline: 11 Nights, 12 Days · Raipur, Bhilai, Bilaspur, Korba, Raigarh, Jagdalpur, Ambikapur, Patiala, Chandigarh, Anandpur Sahib

highlights: Raipur: Explore Chhattisgarh's lively capital through museums, temples, lakes and vibrant local culture.
Bhilai: Discover the city's green side at Maitri Bagh, with peaceful gardens, a zoo and family-friendly attractions.
Bilaspur: Experience regional heritage through Ratanpur's temples, Kanan Pendari Zoo and the city's cultural charm.
Korba: Escape into forested hills, waterfalls and reservoirs around Devpahari, Chaithurgarh and Hasdeo Bango.
Raigarh: Enjoy Ram Jharna's natural beauty, Gomarda's wildlife and the city's rich music-and-dance heritage.
Jagdalpur: Discover Bastar's soul through Chitrakote Falls, Tirathgarh Falls, Kanger Valley and vibrant tribal traditions.
Ambikapur: Explore Mainpat's misty hills, waterfalls, Buddhist heritage and the peaceful beauty of northern Chhattisgarh.
Patiala: Admire royal Punjabi heritage at Qila Mubarak, enjoy the city's refined culture and savour its legendary food traditions.
Chandigarh: Experience India's beautifully planned city through the Rock Garden, Sukhna Lake and Chandigarh's modernist architecture.
Anandpur Sahib: Visit Takht Sri Keshgarh Sahib and Virasat-e-Khalsa, where Sikh history, faith and heritage come alive.

groups.name: Odisha
groups.tagline: 18 Nights, 19 Days · Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Rourkela, Berhampur, Sambalpur, Puri, Balasore, Satkosia, Daringbadi, Bhitarkanika, Similipal, Kuldiha

offer.summary: 19 days trip built around Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Rourkela, Berhampur, Sambalpur, Puri, Balasore, Satkosia, Daringbadi, Bhitarkanika, Similipal, Kuldiha at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you. Rate Valid for Group travel of minimum 15 PAX travelling together
highlights: Bhubaneswar: Explore the Temple City through Lingaraj Temple, Udayagiri-Khandagiri Caves and its graceful Kalinga heritage.
Cuttack: Discover Odisha's historic commercial heart through Barabati Fort, silver filigree artistry and riverside charm.
Rourkela: Experience Odisha's industrial city surrounded by green hills, waterfalls and the peaceful beauty of Khandadhar.
Berhampur: Enjoy the vibrant culture of southern Odisha, with nearby beaches, temples, handloom traditions and the scenic Gopalpur coast.
Sambalpur: Discover western Odisha's cultural soul through Hirakud Dam, Sambalpuri traditions and the sacred Samaleswari Temple.
Puri: Feel the spiritual energy of Jagannath Temple, golden beaches and the timeless coastal atmosphere of Odisha's sacred city.
Balasore: Explore Chandipur's vanishing tide, Panchalingeshwar Temple and the tranquil mangrove beauty of Bichitrapur.
Satkosia: Cruise through the dramatic Mahanadi gorge, surrounded by forested hills, river landscapes and rich wildlife.
Daringbadi: Escape into Odisha's cool hill country, where pine forests, coffee gardens, waterfalls and misty valleys create a peaceful retreat.
Bhitarkanika: Navigate mangrove creeks alive with saltwater crocodiles, migratory birds, spotted deer and serene waterways.
Similipal: Venture into a vast wilderness of dense forests, waterfalls, elephants, tigers and rich biodiversity.
Kuldiha: Discover a quiet forest sanctuary known for elephants, Indian gaur, rich flora and the nearby Panchalingeshwar hills.

groups.name: West Bengal
groups.tagline: 19 Nights, 20 Days · Kolkata, Howrah, Durgapur, Bolpur, Purulia, Bankura, Siliguri, Bardhaman, Malda, Murshidabad, Haldia, Kharagpur, Darjeeling, Alipurduar, Midnapore, Bangaon, Cooch Behar, Sundarbans

offer.summary: 20 days trip built around Kolkata, Howrah, Durgapur, Bolpur, Purulia, Bankura, Siliguri, Bardhaman, Malda, Murshidabad, Haldia, Kharagpur, Darjeeling, Alipurduar, Midnapore, Bangaon, Cooch Behar, Sundarbans at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you. Rate Valid for Group travel of minimum 15 PAX travelling together
highlights: Kolkata: Experience Bengal's cultural soul through Victoria Memorial, St Peters Church, colonial streets, art, literature and vibrant Durga Puja traditions.
Howrah: Pause beside the Hooghly River for iconic views of Howrah Bridge, riverside ghats and the serene greenery of Santragachi Jheel and Botanical Garden.
Durgapur: Discover Bengal's industrial city alongside peaceful escapes such as Durgapur Barrage, Garh Jungle and nearby forest landscapes.
Bolpur: Wander through Santiniketan's artistic world, Sonajhuri forest, Khoai landscapes and the living heritage of Rabindranath Tagore.
Purulia: Explore red-earth hills, Palash forests, Ayodhya Hills, waterfalls and the colourful tradition of Chhau culture.
Bankura: Admire Bishnupur's intricate terracotta temples, then unwind beside Mukutmanipur Dam and Susunia's green hills.
Siliguri: Use this lively gateway to reach Darjeeling and the Dooars, while enjoying tea gardens, markets and Himalayan foothill views.
Bardhaman: Discover the royal charm of Bardhaman through Curzon Gate, historic temples, palaces and tranquil gardens.
Malda: Step into Bengal's medieval past at Gaur, Pandua, Adina Mosque and Firoz Minar, with mango orchards adding local flavour.
Murshidabad: Relive Bengal's Nawabi era through Hazarduari Palace, Katra Mosque, Nizamat Imambara and the Bhagirathi riverside.
Haldia: Enjoy riverside views where the Hooghly meets the Haldi, complemented by peaceful parks, temples and port-city scenery.
Kharagpur: Experience the energy of a major railway town, with nearby forests, lakes and quiet weekend escapes into rural Bengal.
Darjeeling: Wake to Kanchenjunga vistas, misty tea gardens, the historic toy train and the timeless charm of the Queen of the Hills.
Alipurduar: Enter the Dooars through tea gardens, Buxa Tiger Reserve, Jaldapara's wildlife and Bhutan-facing mountain landscapes.
Midnapore: Explore the cultural landscapes of West Bengal through ancient temples, rural heritage, forests and the peaceful Subarnarekha region.
Bangaon: Discover a vibrant border town enriched by local markets, cultural traditions and its connection to the Petrapole frontier.
Cooch Behar: Admire the regal Cooch Behar Palace, historic temples, Sagardighi and the bird-rich waters of Rasik Beel.
Sundarbans: Cruise through a UNESCO-listed mangrove wilderness of winding creeks, island villages and elusive Royal Bengal tigers.

groups.name: Sikkim

highlights: Gangtok: Explore MG Marg, Rumtek Monastery, Tsomgo Lake and Nathula Pass amid serene Himalayan views.
Namchi: Visit Char Dham, Samdruptse and the scenic Temi Tea Garden in Sikkim's spiritual south.
Gyalshing: Discover Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdentse Ruins and the sacred Khecheopalri Lake.
Mangan: Enjoy peaceful mountain scenery, cascading waterfalls and panoramic views from Singhik.
Singtam: Experience a tranquil riverside town surrounded by lush valleys, birdlife and gateways to Dzongu.
Rangpo: Relax in a charming gateway town where rural Sikkimese life meets the flowing Teesta and green hills.
Lachen: Journey towards the sacred Gurudongmar Lake and vast, high-altitude landscapes of North Sikkim.
Lachung: Discover a beautiful mountain village and gateway to Yumthang Valley, Zero Point and rhododendron-filled scenery.
Pelling: Enjoy majestic Kanchenjunga views, the Pelling Skywalk, monasteries, waterfalls and peaceful Himalayan charm.

groups.name: Uttarakhand Cluster 1
groups.tagline: 11 Nights, 12 Days · Corbett, Ranikhet, Almora, Binsar, Kausani, Pithoragarh, Dharchula, Munsiyari, Kainchi Dham, Nainital, Valley of Flowers, Chopta Valley

offer.summary: 12 days trip built around Corbett, Ranikhet, Almora, Binsar, Kausani, Pithoragarh, Dharchula, Munsiyari, Kainchi Dham, Nainital, Valley of Flowers, Chopta Valley at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the India journeys we shape by hand through India, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Corbett: Venture into India's oldest national park for thrilling safaris amid forests, elephants, leopards, and the elusive Bengal tiger.
Ranikhet: Unwind among pine-scented hills, colonial charm, and serene views of the western Himalayas.
Almora: Immerse yourself in rich cultural heritage, ancient temples like Jageshwar, and sweeping views of the snow-capped Himalayas.
Binsar: Retreat into dense oak and rhododendron forests, with sweeping views of Nanda Devi, Trishul, and Panchachuli.
Kausani: Savour tranquil mountain sunsets and expansive Himalayan panoramas from this peaceful hill retreat.
Pithoragarh: Discover a scenic Himalayan valley framed by rugged peaks, ancient temples, and quiet mountain culture.
Dharchula: Experience a dramatic borderland town beside the Kali River, serving as a gateway to Adi Kailash and Kailash Mansarovar routes.
Munsiyari: Trek into the Kumaon Himalayas through panoramic Panchachuli views and trails leading toward remote glaciers.
Kainchi Dham: Visit the serene ashram of Neem Karoli Baba, nestled in a quiet valley and famous for its profound spiritual peace.
Nainital: Enjoy boating on the beautiful Naini Lake, peaceful hill views, and the spiritual charm of Naina Devi Temple.
Valley of Flowers: Trek through this UNESCO World Heritage site, famed for its vibrant alpine meadows, endemic flora, and stunning high-altitude scenery.
Chopta Valley: Explore the 'Mini Switzerland of India,' featuring lush meadows, ancient temples like Tungnath, and breathtaking mountain vistas.
